ctx.x: Yes, thank you, certainly Joni Mitchell, yes. But she had her impact after she moved to Los Angeles and that, you know, I would never have done it on my own, come to the U.S. I certainly didn’t come here and say here I am, you know, how do I get started. Again, it was just a series of crazy fortuitous — right place at the right time things that brought me here.
I was trying to come up with my own description of Paul Shaffer, if someone asked me. And I didn’t really do it except sort of a phrase like whatever comes up I can do it or I will learn to do it.
